notes: THIS FILE CONTAINS NO CERTIFICATE, and that is the finding, not a labelling failure. specs/03 §15 describes G14 as a certificate 'embedded in guidance text'; the committed bytes are five pages of guidance with no ACORD 25 anywhere in them. Page 1 is the City of Boise's numbered checklist for reviewing a certificate, page 2 is the IMPORTANT / DISCLAIMER text that is printed on the REVERSE of an ACORD form, page 3 is an 'ACORD FORMS INSTRUCTION GUIDE' essay, and pages 4-5 are two scanned pages of ACORD's own 'Certificates FAQs'. kb-samples/MANIFEST.md's own row already says as much — it records the edition as '(unstamped)' and describes the file as a 'Quick Tips' gloss. Both were read page by page, at 130 dpi as images and through the text layer, before this was written. See BUILD.md D-16. So document_kind is 'other' and every field is null. That makes G14 a REJECTION fixture in practice: a plausible-looking upload that the pipeline must refuse with the sentence specs/03 A5 specifies, rather than map onto ACORD 25 boxes. It is a valuable one — 'my vendor sent me the instructions instead of the certificate' is a real upload.
